method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: get_public_documentation
tools.title: get_public_documentation
tools.description: Returns metadata and complete source content of an official Raiffeisen Bank Developer Portal (https://developer.raif.ru) document by its catalog ID.

tools.name: list_public_documentation
tools.title: list_public_documentation
tools.description: Lists official public documentation from Raiffeisen Bank's Developer Portal (https://developer.raif.ru). Optionally filters documents by the ru or en language code.

language.description: Optional documentation language: ru or en

tools.name: get_public_api_specification
tools.title: get_public_api_specification
tools.description: Returns the complete specification for a selected Raiffeisen Bank Developer Portal (https://developer.raif.ru) API Router or bundled Code Flow or sandbox API variant.

tools.name: list_public_api_operations
tools.title: list_public_api_operations
tools.description: Returns every operation for one public Raiffeisen Bank Developer Portal (https://developer.raif.ru) API, including bundled Code Flow and sandbox, optionally limited to one variant.

tools.name: list_public_api_variants
tools.title: list_public_api_variants
tools.description: Returns all variants for one public Raiffeisen Bank Developer Portal (https://developer.raif.ru) API from API Router or bundled Code Flow and sandbox documentation.

tools.name: list_public_apis
tools.title: list_public_apis
tools.description: Returns every public API currently available from Raiffeisen Bank's Developer Portal (https://developer.raif.ru), API Router, and bundled Code Flow and sandbox documentation.

tools.name: list_public_scenarios
tools.title: list_public_scenarios
tools.description: Returns every localized business scenario currently available from Raiffeisen Bank's Developer Portal (https://developer.raif.ru), including full public details.

language.description: Optional scenario language: ru or en; defaults to ru
